name: Roblox Genie
description: The lamp-genie NPC any player can chat with in the aw-roblox game: grants small wishes live (spawn objects, move/summon NPCs) and files a Kanban card for bigger ones. Split out of the Roblox app as its own package so the chat-injectable surface a random player talks to never shares a permission boundary with Frederico's full pilot tools (scale_object, kick_players, world lighting).

skills.description: The in-game Genie NPC's own narrow, chat-injection-safe tool surface — what it can and deliberately cannot do, and why.

agent_configs.name: Roblox Genie Config
agent_configs.description: SECURITY-CRITICAL: mcp_servers below is intentionally empty, not aw-gateway. Before dispatching this agent for real, point it at a named MCP Gateway config scoped to ONLY the aw-roblox-genie upstream (see gateway config.py's named_configs / ConfigGateway) — never the full aw-gateway profile. See this app's README for the exact steps.

groups.name: Roblox Genie
groups.description: The lamp-genie NPC persona for the aw-roblox game.

agents.name: Roblox Genie
agents.description: Chat NPC any aw-roblox player can talk to.

roblox_pilot_backend_url.description: Public subdomain of the roblox-pilot-backend custom app that npc-control tools relay through. Must match the same value configured in aw-app-roblox's own Settings — same live game, two apps.

roblox_pilot_backend_api_key.description: API key the roblox-pilot-backend container issued (its own data/api_keys.json). Same key as aw-app-roblox's roblox_pilot_backend_api_key — each app has its own secret store, so this has to be pasted in both places. Required for every npc-control tool; missing it, each tool call says so by name instead of a bare connection failure.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-roblox-genie' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach these tools.

create_genie_card/list_genie_cards call aw-app-notion's Kanban REST mirror (/api/apps/notion/kanban/cards) over the loopback workspace API. Not required to install this app, but both tools return a clear "aw-app-notion not installed" error without it.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan roblox-genie/mcp.json.
